description: This file defines models and methods related to stock location paths and product location rules in an OpenERP/Odoo module, including classes for stock location paths, product products, and stock locations with a method for chained location retrieval.

classes.name: stock_location_path
classes.description: Model representing paths for stock locations, including operation type, source and destination locations, delay, and auto-move settings.

classes.name: product_product
classes.description: Extension of product.product with a one-to-many relation to stock location paths.

classes.name: stock_location
classes.description: Extension of stock.location with a method to get chained locations based on product paths.

methods.name: chained_location_get
methods.description: Retrieves the destination location, auto-move flag, and delay for a given location and product based on defined location paths.
